references.text: Zebul warns Abimelech about Gaal's rebellion and plans to drive him out, leading to the events in verse 41
Gaal speaks against Abimelech and calls for a revolt, resulting in his expulsion in verse 41
Abimelech ruled over Israel for three years before the conflict with Shechem arose, setting the background for the banishment in verse 41
Abraham drove out Hagar and Ishmael, an example of expelling family members from a place
Moses drives away shepherds at the well, another example of chasing someone away from a location
